description: This PHP class defines the model for handling FAQ questions within the Node context of the Goteo application. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, saving, and validating FAQ question data, and manages database interactions for the 'node_faq_question' table.

classes.name: NodeFaqQuestion
classes.description: Model class representing a FAQ question node, with methods for CRUD operations and validation within the application's data layer.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns the list of language-specific fields ('title', 'description') for localization purposes.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a FAQ question object by its ID, throwing a ModelNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns a list of FAQ questions filtered by provided criteria, supports pagination and counting.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current object to the database, inserting or updating as needed.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation checks on the object before saving; currently always returns true unless errors are present.
